identity_definition: identical aligned residues / alignment columns including gaps; alignment-mode3 seq-id-mode0
coverage_definition: inclusive aligned query/target coordinate spans divided by respective full sequence lengths
decisions: integer alignment count/coordinate cross-products, not rounded fident/qcov/tcov display fields
inheritance: union all original parent components, including excluded-parent bridge paths; never split inherited groups
search_scope: all 36485 full-QC v0.10 parent sequences, irrespective of labels; retained14505 only enter training
split: component containing ANY old internal test member -> test; all others -> development; no score/label-based movement
checks: both directions development/test, each pool/OOF validation, each actual train/monitor; union discoveries and repeat all checks
